authorization_context: Owner requested: Aplícalo en canon, after reviewing LAB batch 001.
behavior: Apply exactly ten approved product images to the existing CANON product image field through an append-only authorization event; no general product.update command is introduced.
invariants: Each product name must resolve to exactly one active CANON IMPORT or LIVE product.
Image payload must be jpeg/png/webp/gif data URL <= 180000 characters.
An append-only canonical_product_image_events row must authorize the exact previous and replacement image.
Price, cost, stock quantity, stock revision, SKU, barcode, category, product identity and provenance remain unchanged.
Sales, sale_items, inventory_movements, cash_movements, credit_payments, financial_events and expenses counts remain unchanged.
Production backup must be exported and checksum-verified in private R2 before migration or image writes.
Production Worker must return the exact ten applied images before PASS.

rollback.normal: Append compensating image events that restore each recorded previous_image.
rollback.emergency: Restore the fresh production D1 backup captured by the production workflow before writes.

activation: A separate trigger-only commit is required after implementation merge and CI verification.
